svg.title: Fog forest placement plan v1
svg.desc: Top-down plan view; north (-z) is up. Prop symbols are enlarged for readability.
svg.text: x studs (east is right) | z studs (south is down, north = -z is up)
Fog forest placement plan v1 - top-down
seed 20261107 | 400 x 400 studs | north (-z) is up | symbols enlarged, logs, arch and doorway drawn at measured footprint
Detail: nest, ruin and patrol loop (x -25..80, z -133..-42)
Tree root flare r8 (detail panel only)
Patrol loop (diamond E S W N, home +/-16)
Forest props per 1000 sq studs: fog 2.86, outside 0.58
Dead trees + logs in fog: 52 of 59
Trees and logs keep roots and bases >= 10 studs off the route centreline; lanterns sit 10.5 out, alternating sides.
Footprints are the measured Blender kit: tree roots flare to r8 (trunk core 2.5 / 3.4), arch 31.6 x 16.2, doorway 36.0 x 9.9.
Arch and doorway footprints are reserved; their measured inner clearance (16.3 / 18.6) covers the 14-stud corridor.
Arch footprint overshoots the west fog edge by 1.0 studs; its passage and pivot are inside the fog zone.
Cover trunks (ringed) are 13-26 studs from the nest. The E and N sight lanes stay clear so the guardian can detect players.
Patrol is a diamond E S W N. Detection range 28 by day, 38 by night: E (23.6) by day, E and N (35.1) at night; S and W are blocked by pillars.
Patrol loop length within 28 of the nest: 18%; within 38: 46%.
Lanterns: 40-55 studs apart outside the territory, 62-78 inside; lantern i+2 is always >= 80 studs of route away.
Shade proxy: evergreen canopy r10.4 x scale covers 45% of the fog zone and 20% outside; dead trees are bare.
